draftBefore.emotion: a physical, exerted effort to move something or someone away from yourself
notes: Unlike 'puxar' (to pull), which brings something toward you, 'empurrar' focuses on the force applied outward to displace an object.
Be careful not to confuse this with 'apertar', which means to press or squeeze but without the movement of pushing away.

senses.definition: To apply physical force to move an object away from you.
